evidence.text: The exact file page describes 山-seal.svg as a vector depicting 山 in Shuowen seal-script style. It lists Sinica Database and other sources, identifies a Sinica image as CC0, and states that this file is CC0 1.0. The page links the original SVG. I inspected the attached rendered preview: three upright strokes rise from a curved base, with the central stroke extending below the side strokes.

items.caption: This modern redraw shows three tall strokes rising from a curved base; the central stroke extends below the side strokes. It depicts 山 in Shuowen seal-script style.
items.alt: Three upright strokes, the center taller and longer below, joined by a curved base.
items.selection_reason: The attached preview visibly matches the corrected description and illustrates the seal-style form without presenting it as an ancient artifact.

limitations.text: This is a modern digital redraw, not an ancient inscription photograph; the Commons page identifies its style but does not establish a specimen date.
